title: GL-17 — Athena on a tiny file
stopChargesPanel: Remove Athena results, S3 objects, bucket; no leftover crawler.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on Athena; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Set `$Bucket = "workbook-gl17-$AccountId"`.
Set `$ResultsBucket = "workbook-gl17-results-$AccountId"`.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Results and data buckets
bullets: Run `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $Bucket --region us-east-1`.
Run `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $ResultsBucket --region us-east-1`.
Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl17.csv", "name,value`nfoo,1`n", $utf8)`.
Run `aws s3 cp gl17.csv s3://$Bucket/data/gl17.csv`.
Success: object is in the data bucket.

steps.title: Create database and table
bullets: Run `aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS gl17' --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/`.

Run `aws athena start-query-execution --query-string "CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gl17.sample (name string, value int) ROW FORMAT DELIMITED FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' LOCATION 's3://$Bucket/data/' TBLPROPERTIES ('skip.header.line.count'='1')" --query-execution-context Database=gl17 --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/`.
Success: tables show in glue/athena.

steps.title: Run query
bullets: Run `aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'SELECT * FROM gl17.sample LIMIT 10' --query-execution-context Database=gl17 --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/`.
Success: query succeeds.

steps.title: Drop table and database
bullets: Run `$DropTableId = aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'DROP TABLE gl17.sample' --query-execution-context Database=gl17 --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/ --query QueryExecutionId --output text`.

Run `do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $DropTableState = aws athena get-query-execution --query-execution-id $DropTableId --query QueryExecution.Status.State --output text } while ($DropTableState -eq 'QUEUED' -or $DropTableState -eq 'RUNNING')`.
Run `$DropDbId = aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'DROP DATABASE gl17' --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/ --query QueryExecutionId --output text`.

Run `do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $DropDbState = aws athena get-query-execution --query-execution-id $DropDbId --query QueryExecution.Status.State --output text } while ($DropDbState -eq 'QUEUED' -or $DropDbState -eq 'RUNNING')`.
Success: `$DropTableState` and `$DropDbState` are SUCCEEDED. Do this before you delete the results bucket.

steps.title: Empty buckets
bullets: Run `aws s3 rm s3://$Bucket --recursive`.
Run `aws s3 rm s3://$ResultsBucket --recursive`.
Success: buckets are empty.

steps.title: Delete buckets
bullets: Run `aws s3api delete-bucket --bucket $Bucket`.
Run `aws s3api delete-bucket --bucket $ResultsBucket`.
Success: head-bucket fails for both.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: drop the Athena table, drop the database, then delete the results and data buckets
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-17` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: $DropTableId = aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS gl17.sample' --query-execution-context Database=gl17 --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/ --query QueryExecutionId --output text

if ($DropTableId) { do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $DropTableState = aws athena get-query-execution --query-execution-id $DropTableId --query QueryExecution.Status.State --output text } while ($DropTableState -eq 'QUEUED' -or $DropTableState -eq 'RUNNING') }
$DropDbId = aws athena start-query-execution --query-string 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS gl17' --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://$ResultsBucket/athena/ --query QueryExecutionId --output text

if ($DropDbId) { do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $DropDbState = aws athena get-query-execution --query-execution-id $DropDbId --query QueryExecution.Status.State --output text } while ($DropDbState -eq 'QUEUED' -or $DropDbState -eq 'RUNNING') }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-17 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-17 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-17. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Tiny CSV in S3, one Athena table, one query, drop table and delete outputs.
